source: The catalogue describes this linocut as an edition of 180 prints. Each print carries its own number beneath the image, together with the artist's initials. The paper is unframed, and the dimensions refer to the image rather than the sheet. A proof is shown in the photograph; the print sent to a buyer will have its individual edition number.
objective: Correct the stated edition size to the artist's revised figure. That revised figure has not been provided.
